repositories.name: CADCraft

license.notes: LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE and ATTRIBUTION.md present. The 485-package resolved graph contains MPL-2.0 (acadrust, colored) used unmodified and no GPL-only dependency.

repositories.role: Primary 2D drafting application: DXF R12-2018 read/R2000 write, DWG via acadrust, constraints, layouts, plotting, MCP server and CLI.
repositories.conversion_rationale: Already Rust (618 of 750 files). The remaining Python is one helper script. A language rewrite would destroy working software for a label, which the brief forbids.
known_limitations: Workspace-wide build and the full 2,212-test suite were not run on this 7.4 GB host (docs/build-and-test.md section 3).
No SECURITY.md (security review S-1/process).
Two craft-libs revisions are now vendored and approved under MIT OR Apache-2.0; they remain outside registry advisory feeds, so keep their pins and provenance reviewed.
README states entities CADCraft does not model are not kept on save; the preservation requirement is therefore partial.

repositories.name: SolidCraft

license.notes: LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE, ATTRIBUTION.md and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt present. Vendored truck crates are Apache-2.0 with modifications marked `SolidCraft:`.

repositories.role: Primary parametric 3D application: sketches and constraints, feature timeline, assemblies, sheet metal, STEP/IGES/3MF/STL/OBJ/glTF, desktop + web + CLI + MCP.
repositories.conversion_rationale: Already Rust, and it owns the only production-grade kernel boundary in the workspace (94,803 LOC with no truck types in its public API). It is the integration point, not a migration target.
known_limitations: The 5,884-test suite was not run here; one crate build took 8 min 22 s and peaked at 2.56 GB RSS.
Declares rust-version 1.95 while the installed toolchain is 1.94.0; cargo 1.94 tolerates this but a future cargo may not.
The kernel's boolean differences and chains are separate from the contract adapter; the adapter refuses difference rather than returning a wrong solid.
The git remote (tangency-labs) differs from the repository URL in Cargo.toml (bherbruck), so this checkout is a fork of the declared upstream.
Untrusted-import size and cancellation budgets are missing in crates/io (security S-3).

repositories.name: truck

license.notes: LICENSE file is the Apache-2.0 text; crates.io metadata agrees. Apache-2.0 section 4(d) requires NOTICE preservation when redistributed.

repositories.role: Primary 3D B-rep kernel. The product consumes it through SolidCraft's vendored patched crates, not the published crates alone.
repositories.conversion_rationale: Apache-2.0, pure Rust, and the only kernel with a production integration and an oracle behind it. No rewriting candidate demonstrated an advantage.
known_limitations: Published truck-shapeops fails every coplanar overlapping boolean; four crates are patched under apps/solidcraft/vendor.
A third chained union panics inside intersection_curve.rs (caught as KernelError::Internal, operation unavailable).
Upstream face ordering after a boolean is not stable; SolidCraft's patch restores deterministic ordering.

repositories.role: Read-only reference: a fork/rename of truck. Not integrated and not built on this host.
repositories.conversion_rationale: Kept as a reference outside the shipping graph. Two copies of one kernel would double the test surface with no demonstrated capability gain.
known_limitations: Duplicates upstream truck; no measured advantage.
Not built, so nothing is claimed about it beyond its repository contents.

license.notes: The MIT licence covers cadrum's Rust source only. A binary that statically links headless OpenCASCADE carries LGPL-2.1 obligations. Owner decision G1 is open; do not distribute.

repositories.role: Candidate OCCT-based kernel with a native build. Excluded from the shipping graph for licence reasons.

known_limitations: Statically links LGPL-2.1 OpenCASCADE regardless of the wrapper's MIT licence.
Requires cmake or a prebuilt OCCT tarball; not attempted on this host.

license.notes: Verified from OpenCADStudio-main.zip: LICENSE is the GNU GPL v3 text, 1,797 files, 892 Rust. Copyleft: no code may enter the proprietary product. The archive stays unextracted; the local directory is empty.

repositories.name: craft-libs (external git dependency)

license.notes: Read from the pinned checkouts: workspace Cargo.toml declares MIT OR Apache-2.0, with LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE present. All nine crates use license.workspace = true. The five vendored PDF-backend crates (hayro, hayro-cmap, hayro-interpret, hayro-jbig2, hayro-syntax) carry MIT/Apache dual licences; bundled data assets are CC0-1.0 or BSD-2-Clause style. No copyleft found in either pinned tree. Two revisions vendored into apps/cadcraft/vendor/ with PROVENANCE.md and sha256 manifests: craft-docpath at 82a24b00... (12 unit + 1 doc test pass standalone), craft-ui at 5c874d51... (own compile blocked by pre-existing epaint unstable-feature incompatibility, unrelated to vendoring).

repositories.role: External supply-chain dependency of CADCraft, now vendored at two pinned revisions into apps/cadcraft/vendor/ so release builds do not need GitHub.
repositories.conversion_rationale: Mature dual-licensed (MIT OR Apache-2.0) library; vendored at pinned revisions, so nothing to replace and no network needed for release builds.
known_limitations: Both pinned revisions declare rust-version 1.95; this host has rustc 1.94.0, so CADCraft crates depending on them (engine, ui-egui) cannot be compiled here (pre-existing, unrelated to vendoring).
craft-ui transitively depends on egui 0.36 which uses an unstable library feature (push_mut) unsupported by this host; pre-existing, unrelated to vendoring.
Reproducibility no longer depends on GitHub (vendored), but the pinned MSRV pins the toolchain.

repositories.name: cad-contract

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Shared contract: units, stable IDs, tolerances, capabilities, kernel error taxonomy, mesh exchange, versioned document header.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; there is nothing to convert.
known_limitations: cad-document writes the header in its `.zcad` project; generic header migrations are tested in cad-contract.
No Vec3 of its own by design, so callers keep their own vector types.

repositories.name: cad-kernel-truck

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses. Links Apache-2.0 Truck crates from apps/solidcraft/vendor; those remain under their own license.

repositories.role: Truck-backed implementation of the contract kernel interface: extrude, union, intersection, tessellation.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate wrapping an Apache-2.0 Rust kernel; no foreign code is involved.
known_limitations: Does not advertise boolean difference: the underlying path returns a wrong solid (docs/kernel-comparison.md section 4.2).
Chained unions fail at the third operand (kernel-level, caught as Internal).
Depends on SolidCraft's vendored patched truck crates by path, so it is coupled to that checkout.
Cancellation and deadlines are cooperative checkpoints, not preemption: a single pathological boolean inside truck cannot be interrupted.
Two corpus fixtures are recorded known failures (tangent contact, coordinates near 1e6 mm); they are not regressions and not passes.

repositories.name: cad-engineering

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Integration control plane: typed manifests, workspace scanner, change detection, idempotent task generation, evidence report.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate.
known_limitations: Fingerprinting is FNV-1a 64-bit: fast and reproducible, not cryptographic.
Files over 8 MiB are identified by size and mtime rather than content.
It tracks state; it does not run builds or tests, so evidence records are written by an engineering session or CI.

repositories.name: cad-cli

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Headless product workflow for parametric project creation/editing/rebuild, unit-aware geometry, and binary STL export through cad-io.
repositories.conversion_rationale: A new Rust crate that consumes existing components; nothing was converted.
known_limitations: Only one rectangle sketch and one extrude feature are supported by the native project workflow.
Undo/redo history is persisted with a 64-snapshot bound; named revisions and branching are not implemented.
STL export is binary and carries no units; native `.zcad` project stores units and schema metadata.

repositories.name: cad-agent-api

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: The versioned CadAgent contract: agent identity and metadata, capability and permission declarations, versioned I/O envelopes, budgets and the structured error taxonomy.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; there is nothing to convert.
known_limitations: Declares the agreement only: there is no registry, no scheduler and no enforcement here, by design.
The contract version is a single integer, so there is no minor-version negotiation; a breaking change needs version 2.

repositories.name: cad-agent-runtime

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: The agent runtime: contract validation, the discovered-to-registered-to-ready lifecycle, capability grants, budget enforcement and a strict JSON Schema subset checker.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; there is nothing to convert.
known_limitations: In-process only: the registry is a plain struct with &mut self methods, so one owner at a time and no cross-process isolation.
The schema checker implements a documented keyword subset and refuses any other keyword rather than ignoring it.
No scheduling: a call is synchronous and bounded by the contract's budgets, so a long operation blocks the calling thread.

repositories.name: cad-agent-geometry

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: The geometry-ops agent: the first agent that runs inside the registry, exposing the contract kernel's operations to an agent loop.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; there is nothing to convert.
known_limitations: Boolean difference is refused: the truck adapter does not advertise it, so the agent reports it as unsupported rather than returning a wrong solid.
Solid handles are session handles: they are valid for this agent's lifetime and must never be persisted.
The reply carries measurements, never geometry, so a caller cannot obtain a mesh through the agent.
The workspace file read is bounded to a single JSON profile under 1 MiB; there is no import of any other format.

repositories.name: cad-document

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Local parametric project payload with schema-2 rectangle, circle and regular-polygon sketches, extrude, named parameters, bounded undo/redo, atomic save/load and schema-1 migration.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; no existing source was converted.
known_limitations: One extrude of one sketch; no general sketch entities, constraints, booleans or multi-body features.
A circle is a tolerance-bounded polygon; its volume is the polygon volume, not an analytic cylinder.
Native project files are capped at 64 MiB; undo/redo is limited to 64 snapshots in each direction.
Schema 1 is migrated forward to schema 2 on load; there is no downgrade path.

repositories.name: cad-entitlements

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Local subscription entitlement rules for tiers, quotas and payment lifecycle policy; no billing provider.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; no existing source was converted.
known_limitations: No authentication, persistence, payment gateway, tax calculation, or live billing.
Pricing values are hypotheses, not validated prices.

repositories.name: cad-io

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Validated mesh interchange: binary STL writing and parsing shared by the CLI and studio.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate; the STL code moved out of cad-cli so the studio reuses one implementation.
known_limitations: Binary STL only; no ASCII STL, OBJ or STEP.
STL carries no units, bodies, colours or feature history; callers must keep the document header.

repositories.name: cad-studio

license.notes: The root LICENSE applies personal, non-commercial terms to this first-party AtlasCAD crate. Imported dependencies retain their own licenses.

repositories.role: Local-first application shell: project browser, parameter and profile editing, 3D WebGL viewport with picking and view controls, command palette, themes, atomic save and STL export over a loopback HTTP API.
repositories.conversion_rationale: New Rust crate with dependency-free embedded HTML/CSS/JS; no existing UI was rewritten.
known_limitations: Binds 127.0.0.1 only and serves one project chosen at launch; it is not a hosted or multi-user service.
The viewport is WebGL1 with flat shading; no pixel-level visual regression suite exists.
One extrude of one sketch per project; no sketch drawing tools, constraints, booleans or assemblies.
No autosave or crash-recovery snapshot yet; Save is explicit.
